name: sistemas-ventas-curso
description: Sistema de ventas, inventario y facturación electrónica SUNAT (React + Node.js + MySQL)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sv/shared && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @sv/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @sv/api" "npm run dev -w @sv/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sv/shared && npm run build -w @sv/api && npm run build -w @sv/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sv/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sv/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
